about:
Rich Industries Import Auto Parts has operated from Kansas City, Missouri since 1968. The business was founded to supply new and used auto parts to customers in the Kansas City area and across the United States, later adding import auto restoration and salvage vehicle sales to its offerings.

The company stocks a range of components including A/C wiring harnesses, body wiring harnesses, charging port door assemblies, dash wiring harnesses, deck lid assemblies, diesel particulate filters, and bumper energy absorbers. Beyond parts distribution, Rich Industries provides nationwide parts locating, direct shipping, and restoration services for import vehicles. The facility also handles used and salvaged auto sales, though specific facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers include independent repair shops, restoration specialists, and individual vehicle owners seeking import parts or salvage vehicles. The company’s nationwide parts locating service supports clients who cannot find components locally, while its direct shipping program serves buyers across the country.

Rich Industries differentiates itself with a 90-day warranty on all parts sold, extended warranty options, and a focus on customer service that the company describes as 'professional service meets professional experience.' The business also emphasizes its long-standing presence in the Kansas City market.
